[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance (KRW 1,890,000): resistance zone formed by mid-to-long term moving averages.
· 5-day / 20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal confirmed, possibility of upward trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.99x): normal trading volume, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): consideration for entry as RSI exits oversold and MACD improves.
